title: Project Administrator (Contractor)
summary: Contractor project administrator supporting Bell service delivery in Canada. Coordinate order management, cutovers, and post-implementation reporting for a Project Manager, with a path toward project management.
responsibilities: Manage the administrative lifecycle of project orders, including data and voice services, IT changes, and hardware.
Initiate change requests in client and internal platforms, coordinate equipment shipping, and confirm implementation prerequisites.
Act as central coordination during service implementation and cutovers.
Establish and manage virtual collaboration bridges on Microsoft Teams or Webex.
Guide teams through the Method of Procedure and oversee service testing for a smooth transition to new Bell services.
Validate billing actions such as activations and cessations after implementation.
Close order records with data integrity, track progress, report status, and escalate issues to the Project Manager.
requirements: Proactive, process-oriented approach with close attention to detail.
Strong organizational, time-management, and interpersonal skills.
Strong verbal and written communication with internal and external stakeholders.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, resolve issues or escalate them, in a fast-paced environment.
Desire to grow into project management.
Willingness to work evenings and weekends when order cutovers require it.
niceToHave: Familiarity with Microsoft Teams or Webex.
Prior coordination, project support, or administrative experience.
travel: Remote contractor assignment supporting Bell service delivery in Canada. Evenings and weekends may be required for order cutovers. Work is staff augmentation for a Project Manager.
